In this video, we'll expose the shocking reality of senior citizen health insurance policies - a ₹10 lakh policy that only covers ₹3.5 lakhs. We will also share the framework for finding the best health insurance policy for parents, breaking down the three deadly features to avoid - room rent limits, copayments, and disease-wise sublimits. Learn how to maximise coverage through renewal benefits, restoration benefits, and smart policy combinations. 

This video will give you the knowledge to secure the most favourable coverage despite the insurance industry's tendency to restrict options for seniors. This is a no-nonsense, unsponsored guide to protecting your parents' health and wealth.
